Is barbar dhig kulan isku mid ah iyo heerka bartilmaameedka isla wakhtiga shambabada. Beansprout iyo Investing waxa laga yaabaa inay wadaagaan wax-soo-saarka mustaqbalka, markaa ma aha codad madax-bannaan. Cilmi-baadhista Fed ee New York ee ku taariikhaysan 6 Oktoobar waxay sharraxaysaa si tartiib tartiib ah. Heerka sare ee qiimaha uma baahna macnaheedu waa sicir-bararka sare ee joogtada ah: sicir-bararka sanadlaha ah ayaa laga yaabaa inuu yaraado marka kororka hore uu ka baxo isbarbardhigga. ui_825a86cc728d9569: Sahanka New York Fed ee July wuxuu ogaaday in qaar ka mid ah shirkadaha gobolka ay wali qorsheynayaan kordhinta qiimaha ka dib bixinta canshuuraha. Qiimee qiimaha la xaqiiqsaday, sicir-bararka adeegga iyo filashooyinka sicir-bararka ka hor inta aan la daaweynin cinwaanka tariifada caddayn ahaan go'aan gaar ah.
